Confirms aera-finance/aera-contracts-public is the canonical public GitHub repo. Spearbit audit PDF (380 KB) exists at this path in the main branch. Repo has 22 stars, 14 forks, last updated Aug 25 2025.

Docs site confirms V3 as current version; V2 docs archived under /v2-archive/. Overview describes guardian-based vault system with off-chain intelligence, Merkle-tree constraint enforcement, and modular upgradeability.

V2 architecture: three core contracts per deployment — AeraVaultV2 (vault), AeraVaultAssetRegistry, AeraVaultHooks. Owner is a single account (multisig or governance) controlling all three. Guardian is a separate single account for onchain execution.

AeraVaultV2 inherits IVault, ERC165, Ownable2Step, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard. Immutable state: _feeToken, fee, assetRegistry, wrappedNativeToken. Mutable: hooks address. Error names confirm Aera__ prefix namespace.
AeraV2Factory: single factory per chain; create() deploys vault triplet (AeraVaultV2 + AeraVaultAssetRegistry + AeraVaultHooks); uses CREATE2 with salt. Only one instance required per chain.

Contract name AeraVaultV2 confirmed on Ethereum mainnet at this address. ABI includes Aera__-prefixed errors (CallerIsNotGuardian, CallerIsNotOwnerAndGuardian, CannotRenounceOwnership). Compiled with Solidity 0.8.21, shanghai EVM.
Contract name AeraVaultHooks confirmed on Ethereum mainnet. Source includes src/v2/AeraVaultHooks.sol, IHooks.sol, IVault.sol, Sweepable.sol — matches V2 architecture.

Contract name AeraVaultAssetRegistry confirmed on Ethereum mainnet. Constructor takes owner, vault, assets array (with oracle addresses), numeraireToken, feeToken, wrappedNativeToken, sequencer (Chainlink sequencer uptime feed).

protocol_metadata.about: Aera V2 is a non-custodial onchain treasury vault protocol where DAO and protocol treasuries deposit assets into purpose-built vaults and delegate execution to off-chain Guardians (operated by Gauntlet). Each vault deployment consists of three contracts — AeraVaultV2 (asset custody), AeraVaultAssetRegistry (oracle-priced asset list), and AeraVaultHooks (Merkle-tree calldata constraints) — all deployed by a per-chain AeraV2Factory. Guardians submit transactions constrained by an owner-configured allowlist; only the vault owner (typically a multisig or governance contract) can deposit, withdraw, or change configuration. The protocol supports ERC20 and ERC4626 yield-bearing assets across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, and additional chains.
